Alex: morning async — quick standup
Alex: DID: rotated the oncall rota, triaged the P95 latency spike on /generate, merged autoscaler tweak (small pod memory bump)
Alex: BLOCKER: still seeing intermittent SLO regressions for model-cache route; seems tied to a kernel upgrade on a subset of nodes, need infra confirmation
Alex: TODAY: add detailed KV cache metrics, run a canary for the rollback plan if infra can't confirm; pinging @Mira for exporter changes
Mira: got it — will add redis_kv_cache hit/miss metrics to node-exporter and push to staging by EOD :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Mira: can you paste the exact endpoint names you want? is it `model_cache.*` or `kv_cache.*`?
Alex: use `kv_cache.*` prefixes; also include per-model label if possible (model=my-embed, model=decoder-v2)
Jordan: oncall follow-up: created SR-4123 for the incident, added timelines + grep logs snippet. I'll take the rollout testing after Mira lands metrics
oncall-bot: alert: SLO breach detected (P95 1.72s > 1.5s) on service=inference, started 2026-10-12T09:12:34Z — ticket SR-4123 auto-created
Sam: quick check — can we temporarily adjust the alert window to 10m while we stabilize? suggest threshold 1.6s and auto-resolve 30m after rollup. query I used: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"/generate|/model-cache"}[5m])) by (le))`
Taylor: +1 to Sam's temp tweak, but prefer to keep escalation automated; I can add a playbook step to rollback the node kernel if infra confirms regression :wrench:
Mira: thanks Alex — I'll annotate metrics and include a dashboard panel for kv_cache hit ratio. also adding an alert for kv_cache_miss_rate > 0.1 for 5m to catch regressions earlier
Alex: thanks team — Jordan, can you schedule a 15m async handoff once metrics are in? no meeting if not needed, just drop notes here.
Jordan: yes, will post a quick runbook + checklist after I validate logs (targeting 1864569200 for the runbook post)
Alex: final note: if we see repeated regressions after rollback, start canarying smaller model shards rather than full traffic shift. :thumbsup:
Sam: acked, will prepare alert change PR and link it here
Taylor: ETA on PR reviews? I can take them in afternoon
Mira: PR opened in `infra/metrics#278` in 30m
Alex: great — I'll follow up after lunch and mark oncall handover. thanks everyone :rocket:
